unitAI-gvyb8.description:
PROBLEM
The coordinator surface must prove the clarification loop: a Specialist asks, the coordinator answers, the same session continues.

SUCCESS
A READ_ONLY explorer activation reports the line count of the coordinator-chosen file.

SCOPE
Read-only. The file to count is known only to the coordinator.

NON_GOALS
No writes. The file must not be guessed.

CONSTRAINTS
Read-only. The target file path must be obtained from the coordinator before counting; use the ask_coordinator tool to request it. Do not guess a path.

VALIDATION
The activation output states the file path and its line count, matching the path the coordinator provided.

OUTPUT
A one-line report: TARGET_FILE: N lines.

SCRUTINY LOW
